chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
If people knew how the creation began, no two would disagree.

Indeed God — Mighty and Majestic — before He created creation, said: 'Be sweet water! I shall create from you My Paradise and the people of My obedience. And be bitter water! I shall create from you My Fire and the people of My disobedience.'
Then He commanded them both, so they were blended. Thus it came about that the believer begets the disbeliever and the disbeliever begets the believer.

Then He took clay from the surface of the earth and kneaded it with an intense kneading, and they were like tiny particles crawling about. So He said to the companions of the right hand: 'To Paradise in peace!' And He said to the companions of the left hand: 'To the Fire, and I do not care!'

Then He commanded a fire, so it blazed. He said to the companions of the left: 'Enter it!' But they were terrified of it. So He said to the companions of the right: 'Enter it!' And they entered it. So He said: 'Be cool and a safety!' And it became cool and a safety.

The companions of the left said: 'O Lord, forgive us!' He said: 'I have forgiven you, so enter it.' They went but were terrified of it. Thus from that point, obedience and disobedience were established — these ones do not have the capacity to be from those, nor those from these.

key_terms.أصحاب الشمال: Companions of the left hand — those destined for Fire, a Quranic expression (56:9)
key_terms.أصحاب اليمين: Companions of the right hand — those destined for Paradise, a Quranic expression (56:8)
key_terms.ابتداء الخلق: The origination/beginning of creation — the cosmological event before the physical world
key_terms.الطاعة والمعصية: Obedience and disobedience — the fundamental moral division established at creation

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of Imam al-Baqir say about how creation began and why believers beget disbelievers?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) narrates a cosmological hadith explaining the primordial origins of belief and disbelief. Before creation, God designated two primordial waters — one sweet for Paradise and the obedient, one bitter for Hell and the disobedient — and then mixed them, which is why a believer can beget a disbeliever and vice versa. The hadith then describes the covenant event (mithaq) where the pre-existent souls were tested with fire: those of the right hand entered obediently and were made safe, while those of the left refused even after being forgiven, establishing the eternal division between the obedient and the disobedient.
word_analysis: but they were terrified of it

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban Bin Usman, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>
having said: ‘If the people knew how the creation began, no two would differ.

Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, before He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Began the creation, Said: “Be sweet water! I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> shall Create from you, My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Paradise and the people who obey Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>. And be bitter water! I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> shall Create from you, My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Fire and the people who disobey Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>”.

Then, He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Commanded both of them, so they were blended. Thus, from that the Believer came to beget the disbeliever, and the disbeliever (begetting) the Believer.

Then he (the Kalimat-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>) grabbed a clay from the crust of the earth, and kneaded it with an intense kneading, and they were like the particles, crawling. So He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> said to the companions of the right hand: “To the Paradise in peace”, and Said to the companions of the left hand: “To the Fire, and I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> don’t Care”.

Then He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Commanded a fire, so it inflamed, and He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Said to the companions of the left: “Enter into it”. But they were terrified of it. So He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Said to the companions of the right: “Enter into it”. So they entered it. So He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Said: “Be cool and a safety”. So it was cool and safe.

So the companions of the left said, ‘O Lord! Forgive us!’ So He <sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>Said: “I Forgive you. So enter into it’. So they went but were terrified of it. So from then was affirmed the obedience and the disobedience. Thus, these ones do not have the capacity that they happen to be from those, and those ones do not have the capacity to be from these’.
en.sarwar: 1. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari and Muhammad ibn Yahya have narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from Zurara from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:
“Had people known how the beginning of the creation was, no one would have disagreed with another person.

Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, before creating the creatures said, ‘Be a sweet water so I create from you My paradise and people who obey My commands. Be very salty water; from you I create My fire and those who disobey Me.’
He then commanded them to mix and from this the believers give birth to unbelievers and the unbelievers give birth to the believers.

Then He took a clay from the surface of the earth and kneaded it very strongly whereby they (children of Adam) appeared as particles crawling about. He then said to the people of the right hand, ‘To paradise (you go) in peace.’ To the people of the left hand He said, ‘To the fire (you go) and I am not concerned.’

He then commanded a fire that began to blaze and He said to the people of the left hand, ‘Enter therein.’ They then were frightened thereby. He then said to the people of the right hand, ‘Enter the fire.’ They then entered therein and He said, ‘O fire be cool and peaceful.’ The fire became cool and peaceful.

The people of the left hand then said, ‘O Lord forgive us and reduce our burden.’ The Lord said, ‘I have reduced it for you. Enter.’ They went but were afraid of it. It was there that obedience and disobedience came to take place. Thus, these will not be able to become of those and they will not be able to become of these.’”
